title: File camera accepts a truncated RAW payload
description:
- Location: indigo_drivers/ccd_simulator/indigo_ccd_simulator.driver:761-771. Cross-component contract: indigo_libs/indigo_uni_io.c:1995-2027; allocation semantics indigo_libs/indigo_bus.c:1795-1802 and indigo/indigo_bus.h:1041-1047. - Severity: medium; confidence: high; category: functional/data validation. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking follow-up. - Evidence: header and pixel indigo_uni_read return values are converted to bool. That API returns a short positive byte count at EOF and -1 on error, both truthy. Shape/signature arithmetic checks do not prove bytes were actually read. - Impact: truncated pixel input can connect as a valid file camera and produce full-size images with a zero-filled unread tail. Allocation is zero-initialized, so this finding does NOT claim uninitialized memory disclosure. No runtime reproduction performed. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-5). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
